data.title: 奥萝拉 · 血月封印渊薮的千刃齐发
data.description: 巨大血月统治的深渊封印祭坛天穹，狂暴的鲜血魔力化作数以千计的深红晶刺长矛浮悬半空。奥萝拉红裙飘卷立于虚空，俯瞰凡尘冷笑。
data.location: vast volcanic abyss beneath a gigantic looming crimson blood moon
data.action: floating in midair commanding hundreds of hovering crystalline blood spears, dark dress billowing, regal fanged smirk of supreme malice
data.lighting: 巨大血月赤芒与血晶锐刺红光
data.promptProse: Aurora the Witch of Calamity floats under an ominous giant blood moon, commanding arrays of crystalline blood lances with a triumphant smirk.
data.animaCaption: Vivid crimson spears hum with power around her billowing robe under the blood moon. Crimson light reveals her face and the spears and rocks around her.
